# Spider by Fluri Themes

> Open-source TypeScript website spider animation. A jumping spider descends on white silk, roams the document, hides behind DOM content and physically builds persistent webs around page anchors.

Creator: František Gejdoš (Frantisek Gejdos), founder of Fluri Themes. Biography: https://fluri.xyz/founder/

- Demo and installation: https://spider.fluri.xyz/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fluritheme/spider
- Source and full API reference: https://github.com/fluritheme/spider
- README: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fluritheme/spider/main/README.md
- Privacy: https://spider.fluri.xyz/privacy/
- Fluri Themes: https://fluri.xyz/
- Winter snowfall effect: https://winter.fluri.xyz/

Install: npm install @fluritheme/spider. Import createSpider, start on the client after mounting, destroy on unmount. Runtime has no external dependencies or telemetry. Supports reduced motion, explicit targets and layered DOM occlusion; see README for supported geometry and limits. Scrolling keeps silk attached to the document while the resident continues moving.
